title: Enterprise Connectivity: refund rails
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following refund rails for each named contract tier. Refund destinations, restricted to the original payment rail; string list.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | refund rails | ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | refund rails | ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | refund rails | ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | refund rails | ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | refund rails | ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | refund rails | ach; wire; card |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the refund rails is ach; wire; card.
